ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the upper left of the figure there is a fixed point; spring A connects obliquely downward from the upper-left fixed point to the small ball on the left, and beside it it is marked that the angle between spring A and the vertical dashed line is 30°; spring B connects the two identical small balls on the left and right; spring C connects horizontally from the small ball on the right to the right-side wall, and the system is stationary. Then reason: regard the two small balls and spring B as one whole; spring B is an internal force on the whole and can cancel out. The external forces on the whole are: the total gravity of the two balls 2mg, the tension T_A of spring A along the direction of A, and the horizontal tension T_C of spring C. When in static equilibrium, in the vertical direction there is T_A cos30° = 2mg; in the horizontal direction there is T_C = T_A sin30°. Therefore T_A / T_C = 1 / sin30° = 2. The three springs are completely identical, and the stiffness coefficients are the same. From Hooke's law, it can be known that the elongation is proportional to the elastic force, so the ratio of the elongations of springs A and C is 2∶1. Final answer: 2∶1

method.method_draft: 先读图：弹簧A从左上固定点斜向下连接左球，弹簧B连接两球，弹簧C从右球水平连接右侧墙；A与竖直方向成30°，C水平。把两个小球作为一个整体受力分析，弹簧B是内力可抵消。整体外力只有两球总重力2mg、弹簧A沿A方向的拉力T_A、弹簧C水平向右的拉力T_C。静止平衡：竖直方向 T_A cos30°=2mg；水平方向 T_C=T_A sin30°。所以 T_A/T_C=1/sin30°=2。三根弹簧完全相同，劲度系数相同，由胡克定律伸长量与弹力成正比，因此弹簧A、C伸长量之比为2∶1。

最终答案：2∶1
